{{Quote|Bom Vimdin is a true mercenary: one who would sell his soul, the fate of his people, and even that of the galaxy for a few credits. He cares little for what happens to those he harms provided the credit balance in his account grows.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Bom Vimdin''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A pessimistic, reclusive being, he had no loyalties to anyone other than himself, and cared only for his [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] balance. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was a regular at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], though he was widely disliked. Vimdin worked for a wide array of corrupt and dishonorable officials in his life, though his operations thrived during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

The Advozse made great profits transporting fugitive [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] from New Republic territory to those controlled by the Empire, and although he was caught and apprehended many times, his loyal network of spies were able to free him. Eventually, his activities were deemed a threat to the New Republic and Security Chief [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] added him to his [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|most wanted list]]. Thought to be one of the best at his profession, Vimdin was a wealthy being for most of his life, though he completely shunned the company of others.

==Biography==
[[File:Bom_Vimdim_btm.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Bom Vimdin in Chalmun's Cantina.]]
Bom Vimdin, a native of [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]], was born in [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="WBC" /> Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] he was wanted for numerous "crimes against the Empire," and a security alert for him was displayed in places such as [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="Star Tours 2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> Vimdin was in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] for the first time in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> He later boasted about being inside the cantina when the two met, though no one either believed him or cared.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|307|Vimdin, Bom}}</ref>

After the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Vimdin was apprehended while transporting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents to territory still loyal to the Galactic Empire on more than one occasion. However, he regained his freedom each time with outside help, and by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] there was a 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] reward for his capture.<ref name="WBC" /> Vimdin eventually had a son, [[Brin Bimdin|Brin]], who became an exceptional pilot and an agent of the Advozsec resistance against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="GMR">{{GamerCite|4|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Advozsec}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:BomVimdin.jpg|thumb|right|140px|Bom Vimdin.]]
Vimdin was willing to work for anyone with sufficient credits. A cold and calculating individual, he would also consider future favors as payment in the form of smuggling unspecified cargoes.<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />

Vimdin preferred to work for corrupt officials, including the Galactic Empire. He was very pessimistic, territorial, and demanded high prices for his work, but according to Han Solo, Vimdin was among the best in the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] business. General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], who added Vimdin to his most wanted list, was certain that Vimdin would sell his soul and that of his people for a few credits. Although he had been captured more than once, nobody was able to retrieve any information from him regarding the officials who worked for him and protected him.

==Equipment==
Vimdin owned a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc]] freighter called the ''[[Blood Freeze]]''.<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vimdin appeared at the table with [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]], [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Brainiac]], [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]], and [[Braconnor Bakiska/Legends|Braconnor Bakiska]]. The character also appears sporadically and randomly in the non-[[canon]] game ''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]''.

During the shooting of the Cantina scenes he was given the name '[[Wikipedia:Don Rickles|Don Rickles]]'.<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call">''{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}''</ref> His mask was provided by [[Rick Baker]]. He got his name from [[West End Games]].

In the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', "Bom Vindim" appears as an example name. This is likely a misspelling of Bom Vimdin. The name is also misspelled "Bom Vimdim" in several sources.

The character was briefly mentioned in the book ''[[The Secret of the Fortune Wookiee]]''.
